description: Verify an Eformogi receipt id with no login and no API key: the same check the public /verify page performs. Returns the kind, the title or course fields, the issued date, and the signers' names and identity levels, worded exactly as the page words them. Never an email, a user id, or a person id.

id.description: An Eformogi receipt id: tr_, cr_, ws_, att_, wn_, wl_, or kb_ followed by 12 hex characters.

name: verify_record
